attempts.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial): built a local apt repository under /tmp/localrepo containing sl_3.03-17build1_i386.deb with dpkg-scanpackages-generated Packages.gz, served it via python3 http.server bound to $NODE_IP:8080, blackholed the real Ubuntu mirrors (archive/security/ports/esm.ubuntu.com) via /etc/hosts to prove they were unreachable, ran apt-get update showing remote sources fail (connection refused) while the local repo succeeds, then installed sl entirely from the local repo (Need to get 0 B, apt-cache policy shows the 10.100.29.10:8080 source). Restored normal DNS/network afterward. Completed mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id, triggered a deferred systemd-run reboot so the ack returned first, polled until SSH/exec access returned, confirmed a new boot_id (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and verified post-restart that the sl package data/install state persisted on disk and normal internet reachability was restored.
